title: Secure Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform Capstone
objective: Build, verify, and document a production-style commerce application with multiple roles, private records, external integrations, and sensitive transactions.
skills: Customer, supplier, delivery, and administrator roles
Secure registration, authentication, recovery, and sessions
Server-side pricing, inventory, and transaction-state checks
Webhook signature verification and duplicate-event protection
API validation, limits, and security headers
Unit, integration, authorization, and security regression tests

required_features: Customer, supplier, delivery, and administrator roles
Secure registration, authentication, recovery, and sessions
Server-side pricing, inventory, and transaction-state checks
Webhook signature verification and duplicate-event protection
API validation, limits, and security headers
Unit, integration, authorization, and security regression tests
stretch_features: Add risk-based test prioritization and traceability to a relevant ASVS requirement.
Add a clear operational recovery/rollback note and a privacy-aware evidence-retention policy.
tests: Tests for valid and invalid input/roles/states as applicable.
Negative tests for denied permissions and failure paths.
Regression tests for every confirmed finding fixed.
Manual review of deployment/configuration assumptions where automation cannot prove behavior.
review_method: Human review plus local unit/integration tests and controlled manual verification. CodeLeaf does not execute submitted server-side code in the FastAPI process; use only a separate isolated runner if execution automation is later added.
status_note: This is a design-and-review capstone, not a prebuilt commerce codebase. Build in a private development environment with provider test-mode credentials and synthetic data. All test targets must be owned, local, intentionally vulnerable training fixtures, or explicitly authorized. Provider integrations use test mode and synthetic data.
